## A Lamp That Isn't Going Anywhere

A lamp hangs at rest from a single string tied to the ceiling.

**Predict:** What is the tension in the string?

options.text: Less than the lamp's weight — the string only has to hold it up, not fight anything else.
Equal to the lamp's weight — since the lamp isn't accelerating.
More than the lamp's weight — the string has to fight gravity, which makes it work harder.
